courses.title: Prompt Engineering and Evaluation in Practice
courses.description: Prompt Engineering and Evaluation in Practice focuses on prompt engineering and evaluation for people working toward a LLM Engineer role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces cross-functional engineering collaboration, enough to apply alongside prompt engineering and evaluation in real LLM Engineer work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to prompt engineering and evaluation and show how cross-functional engineering collaboration supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying prompt engineering and evaluation to a real LLM Engineer scenario
Practicing prompt engineering and evaluation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to cross-functional engineering collaboration
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Model Deployment Pipelines
courses.description: Applying Model Deployment Pipelines goes beyond the basics of model deployment pipelines, for people already working toward a LLM Engineer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in model deployment pipelines and want to go further.

courses.title: A Short Guide to Evaluation Metrics for Language Models
courses.description: A Short Guide to Evaluation Metrics for Language Models is a short introduction to evaluation metrics for language models for people moving toward a LLM Engineer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show evaluation metrics for language models in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if evaluation metrics for language models is new to you.
